purpose: answer a user report of garbled output plus collapsing MTP acceptance on the context edition, and record whether the pinned image carries upstream vLLM PR #51812

reported_by.symptoms: intermittent multilingual token soup with repeated blocks and replacement characters after 1-2 turns, HTTP 200, no crash; SpecDecoding acceptance walking 39.4 % -> 0.0 % -> 64.5 % -> 20.4 % -> 0.0 %
reported_by.config_of_note: --enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align with --speculative-config mtp depth 3, LMCache 0.5.2 in kv_both disk mode, --max-model-len 196608, --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92

upstream.title: [Bugfix] Align Qwen GDN gates with speculative tokens
upstream.mechanism: mixed_qkv is gathered with spec_token_indx but the fused recurrent update received the unsorted a and b gate tensors, so the kernel's first T_spec gate rows can belong to different tokens than the gathered Q/K/V rows; it bites only when a mixed batch places non-speculative tokens before speculative ones
upstream.upstream_measured_effect: on Qwen3.5-2B BF16 TP1 eager, mean absolute chosen-logprob error 0.002755 -> 0.000208 and maximum 0.020539 -> 0.001690, with identical greedy token ids in their repro

verdict.image: voipmonitor/vllm@sha256:820181fbbc975cd5291c411cda9771d58fecee1636d916f508f47230df20592b (built 2026-08-10, one day before the fix merged)
evidence: vendored line 1298 gathers mixed_qkv_spec with spec_token_indx
vendored lines 1420-1427 pass a=a and b=b unsorted into fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update on the speculative branch
the identifiers a_spec and b_spec do not occur anywhere in the vendored file

patch_published.derivation: the vendored file with exactly the upstream two-hunk change applied: gather a and b with spec_token_indx alongside mixed_qkv_spec, keep the pure-speculative fast path unchanged, and pass a_spec/b_spec to the recurrent update
patch_published.validation: ast.parse on the host and py_compile under the image's own python 3.12.3 both succeed; the unified diff against the vendored file is exactly the upstream diff
patch_published.not_yet: no runtime measurement of this patch exists yet; it is offered as a mount-in fix and is not part of the qualified image digest

likely_primary_cause_of_the_report.which: not this PR, but the absent PR #51113 mamba align-mode chunk splitting, receipt receipts/mamba-align-defect.json
likely_primary_cause_of_the_report.why: the reporter explicitly enables prefix caching and align mode, which is the exact path where the pinned image publishes a truncated GDN recurrent state that a later request over a shared prefix consumes silently; that matches every reported symptom - wrong tokens with HTTP 200, acceptance collapsing to zero because the draft state is garbage, onset after a turn or two once a cache hit lands, and persistence until restart. Upstream measured #51812's own effect as sub-argmax logit drift, which degrades acceptance but is not a plausible source of token soup on its own.
likely_primary_cause_of_the_report.our_published_numbers: unaffected either way: prefix caching is default-off for this hybrid model, every published measurement ran with enable_prefix_caching=False, and the physical-5090 qualification reproduced that (receipts/qualification-5090-context.json)
likely_primary_cause_of_the_report.decisive_test_for_the_reporter: drop --enable-prefix-caching (and --mamba-cache-mode align) and repeat the workload; if the garbling stops, it is #51113

mamba_align.evidence: upstream's own CPU-only regression file fails 14 of 20 against the vendored scheduler and passes 20 of 20 patched

remediation_offered.image_variant: localhost/vllm:gg-r34-patched-apc already bakes the scheduler fix and is marked qualified:false in receipts/production-image.json; the GDN gate module is not in any image yet
